short_description: Acne is a common skin condition where pores become blocked by oil, dead skin cells, and bacteria, causing pimples, blackheads, whiteheads, and sometimes inflamed painful bumps.
temporary_advice: Wash the face gently twice daily with a mild cleanser
Avoid touching, squeezing, or picking pimples
Avoid heavy oily creams or makeup
Be patient because acne improvement can take weeks
avoid: Avoid applying random creams without advice
risk_notes: Acne is usually not dangerous, but severe or untreated acne can cause scars, dark marks, pain, and emotional stress.
when_to_see_doctor: If acne is severe, painful, or cystic
If acne leaves scars or dark marks
If pimples contain pus or swelling increases
If acne does not improve after basic skincare
If acne affects confidence or daily life
